C0538.title: Man Sentenced for Malicious Order Cancellations Causing Over 540,000 Yuan in Losses
C0538.summary: Starting in September 2022, Wu repeatedly placed orders on Shenzhen Fei Company's Pinduoduo store and immediately requested returns and refunds due to a personal dispute with a former coworker. After receiving a public-security penalty, he repeated the conduct from April to June 2023, with transaction value reaching 544,762.42 yuan and service-fee losses of 3,269.19 yuan. Longgang District Court convicted him of sabotaging production and operation and sentenced him to eight months in prison; Shenzhen Intermediate Court upheld the judgment on appeal.
